content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

Bitcoin payments for digital downloads represent a shift towards decentralized commerce. Unlike traditional platforms that charge hefty fees—Gumroad, for instance, takes 10% from every sale—NOWPayments only charges 0.5%. This difference can be monumental; for example, on a $97 product, 100 sales monthly means retaining an extra $921. This architecture empowers creators by reducing costs and providing direct access to funds, crucial for those in financial systems that restrict conventional payment methods.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of Bitcoin payment processing for digital downloads is a combination of reliable infrastructure components. Using Cloudflare Pages or Google Apps Script for hosting, combined with NOWPayments for real-time payment processing, creators can set up a seamless transaction experience. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, ensuring immediate confirmation and delivery of the digital product. This setup not only enhances user experience but also guarantees data sovereignty, as creators retain full ownership of their sales data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are often locked out of mainstream payment platforms. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or design assets, this solution caters to those in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela, where conventional payment options are scarce. The challenge is not just making sales; it’s about maintaining operational control. With this architecture, creators can focus on their work rather than being hindered by financial barriers.
Transform your sales with lower fees—retain more revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully implement Bitcoin payments for digital downloads, you’ll need several components working in harmony. The Edge Commerce Stack offers a foundational setup with Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order management. Integrating NOWPayments ensures that transactions are processed efficiently, while Google Drive can be used for secure file delivery. Each part of this stack is designed to work together, making deployment straightforward and effective.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first, choose your products and create a GitHub repository for your digital downloads. Next, deploy your site using Cloudflare Pages, ensuring it's connected to NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin transactions. Upload your digital products to Google Drive, generating shareable links for immediate delivery upon purchase. Finally, implement the backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order fulfillment. Check out the Edge Commerce Stack for a streamlined deployment process and 30-day support.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Reclaim control of your digital products with decentralized payment systems.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Edge Commerce Stack for a complete infrastructure solution. You can create a store that operates solely on cryptocurrency, ensuring that you keep more of your earnings. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
